evidence.decision: Matches routine state, consequential completion, unavailable actions and unexpected irreversible loss to distinct feedback intensity and truth sources.
evidence.artifact: Requires event/message/channel/next-step contract and the revised feedback/recovery artifact, not generic encouragement.
evidence.transformation: Transfer example moves the completion cue from premature press to confirmed transfer, adds failure recovery and reduces noisy Copy alerts.
evidence.verification: Verifies success, rejection, delay and muted/nonvisual interpretation; false success, sound-only critical information and interruption overload fail.
evidence.applicability: Watch waiting guidance allows later notification; hardware channels and Linux evidence boundaries remain explicit.
evidence.handoffs: Alerts, Progress indicators and Playing haptics load only when selected feedback requires those details.
evidence.distinctiveness: Consequence-based intensity and confirmed-outcome timing distinguish this from a universal loading-state checklist.
